episodes.title: How we scaled our app to 40 thousand dollars a month with zero dollars spent
summary: An X article by app co-founder Nicholas on growing an app to about 40 thousand dollars a month with organic video.
The method: a decent app built fast, heavy daily posting with trial reels, AI-assisted editing, and tested calls to action.
It is a sponsored, self-reported playbook; some tactics, like buying followers or planted comments, carry real risks.
